snippet.title: Tako Bubble Trailer
snippet.description: Tako Bubble is a turn-based casual puzzler. You play as Tako, a yellow octopus, to crawl through deep-ocean environments, defeat ferocious monsters, pop all the bubbles, and find hidden beetle gems. http://noice2d.com/takobubble
